verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents an official CLI for AI reviews before you commit, including reviewing uncommitted local changes. The docs also claim reviews can run in CI/CD pipelines, and Claude Code can trigger CLI reviews, which suggests agent-consumable output. No evidence shows a machine-readable output format such as JSON that tooling can parse, and the CI usage is a one-line claim without documented scripting. missing for 10: documented machine-readable output (e.g., JSON/structured flags), concrete CI script usage docs, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.
